title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: SailPoint Identity Security Cloud
providers.scope_notes: Covers SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (SailPoint Human Fabric). SaaS tenant (docs now branded SailPoint Human Fabric); VA is customer-hosted; no plan gating found for these token controls.

controls.name: accessTokenValiditySeconds
controls.what: Sets how long each issued bearer token lives (PAT default 43200s).

controls.name: Scopes
controls.what: Select scopes to narrow access below the user level; UI default is a no-authorization scope, API default is sp:scopes:all.
controls.setting: Scopes checkboxes on PAT / API client forms

controls.name: Delete API client (Bulk Delete)
controls.what: Delete API clients on the API Management tab or via DELETE /oauth-clients/{id}.
controls.setting: Admin > Global > Security Settings > API Management > Bulk Delete

controls.name: API client enabled flag
controls.what: OAuth client objects carry an enabled flag that can be patched.

controls.name: Refresh Token validity
controls.what: Choose refresh token lifetime when enabling the Refresh Token grant (default 1 month).
controls.setting: New API Client > Refresh Token dropdown

controls_unknown: Any org setting to disable PAT creation or require approval for PATs/API clients
Any admin-enforced maximum PAT lifetime (API states no upper limit on expirationDate but the doc only says this, not that no policy exists)
Whether Network Settings IP/geo restrictions apply to /oauth/token or API calls
Whether deleting a PAT or API client invalidates already-issued bearer tokens (scope changes do not affect existing bearer tokens)
Audit event names for PAT/API client create, use, delete (published sample list is partial and lists none)
Whether API read calls (search, list identities) produce audit events
Whether disabling the owning identity stops its PATs
VA key lifetime, rotation and use logging

auth_paths.name: API client - authorization code / refresh token

authentication.summary: A user signs in at the tenant authorize endpoint; the app exchanges the code for a JWT and, if the client has REFRESH_TOKEN, a refresh token.

federation.details: Initial authorization goes through the tenant login, which works with SSO. Refresh token use is not documented to re-check the IdP.

ip_restriction.boundary: Network Settings (CIDR network definition, country allow/block lists) restrict sign-in per identity profile and are skipped under SSO. Docs do not say they apply to /oauth/token or API calls.

lifetime.summary: Refresh token default 1 month (UI); per-client refreshTokenValiditySeconds

renewal.summary: Refresh grant returns new access and refresh tokens.

administration.summary: Same API Management controls as sailpoint-2: grant types, redirect URIs, consent, scopes, enabled flag, delete.

sso.details: The user signs in to the tenant during the authorization code flow, which docs say works with SSO and strong authentication; refresh-token use afterwards is not described as re-checked.

inventory.details: The API Management page lists the API clients with their grant types; no page or endpoint was found that lists the refresh tokens issued to users.

sso.ui: Admin > Global > Security Settings > Service Provider (remote IdP for SSO); or Admin > Identity Management > Identity Profiles > Sign-in Method = Multifactor Authentication

log_sources.name: Search > Events (events index, POST /search)
log_sources.notes: Kept one year plus current month; older up to 5 years via support request.

anomaly_cues: PATs or clients with sp:scopes:all or no expiry
lastUsed on stale tokens (updated once a day)

containment.steps: Delete or disable the API client.
containment.notes: Refresh token revocation endpoint not documented.
